join.title: Apply to join XKnot
join.lede: Running a Knot site? Leave its details here. Every application is read by an operator before the site appears on the map.
join.step2desc: We check the site is live and self-hosted.
join.step3desc: Approved sites join the manifest at the next rebuild.
join.terms: By submitting, the site agrees to the federation terms: it hosts no other instance's content, and accounts and data stay on its own domain.
